facts.fact: FDSUT secretary general Rose Gaye Ndao said the government is working to mobilise the remaining 150 billion FCFA to deploy the New Deal technologique fully, aiming to bring connectivity to the most remote areas.

SEN.note: No state budget line or fund collection stated; funds said gathered are 900bn FCFA under a public-private partnership.
900bn FCFA is said to be gathered for a programme under a public-private partnership, but no signed deal or private partner amount is stated.
